headline: Nvidia's Jensen Huang dismisses AI existential-risk fears, rejects slowdown calls
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said there is a '0% chance' AI destroys the world by 2030, dismissing warnings from AI-safety advocates, including a former Anthropic researcher, as unsubstantiated doomsday narratives, and said the industry should keep developing AI as fast as possible.
